stories.new_fact: AP reported senators from both parties reached a deal on permitting legislation to speed reviews for energy and infrastructure projects.
stories.new_takeaway: Power and infrastructure approval timelines are becoming a national growth constraint; final bill text matters more than deal language.
stories.why_now: The bipartisan deal was announced and reported September 30, inside the 24-hour priority window.
stories.previous_coverage: Recent national segments covered consumer confidence, trade actions, fuel rules, Iran/oil, and summit follow-up; no full permitting segment in the previous seven scripts.
stories.uncertainty: The deal still must survive Congress; faster reviews could shift rather than resolve litigation, environmental objections, state authority and local cost disputes.
stories.watch: Whether bill text changes agency deadlines, court review, transmission siting or eligible project categories.

stories.new_fact: WOSU reported KKK flyers were found near World Language Middle School and Indian Springs Elementary School in Clintonville, and Worthington police confirmed flyers placed in Worthington Monday night.
stories.new_takeaway: The practical local story is school-day support, documentation and community response to targeted intimidation, not amplifying anonymous propaganda.
stories.why_now: The flyers were found September 29 and the school/community responses began the same day.
stories.previous_coverage: Recent local segments covered venue access, traffic-safety grants, police investigations, water/rate design, and snow preparation; no repeated fact or conclusion.
stories.uncertainty: Distribution scope, any suspect identification, and repeat activity remain unknown at cutoff.
stories.watch: Reports from Worthington, Columbus schools, police or community groups on distribution patterns, cleanup costs, suspect identification or student-support steps.

stories.new_fact: Fannie Mae posted LL-2026-08 for temporary UAD 3.6 exceptions on September 30; Freddie Mac posted September 30 pricing alignment across Classic FICO and VantageScore 4.0.
stories.new_takeaway: October becomes an implementation month for appraisal data readiness, loan delivery, pricing communication, investor instructions and score-model quality control.
stories.why_now: Both primary-source mortgage implementation updates were dated September 30.
stories.previous_coverage: Previous lending segments covered NFIP deadline relief, MPF servicing, Fannie rental income, ARM counseling, MBS disclosure and LoanPro servicing; no UAD 3.6 exception or VantageScore pricing-alignment lead.
stories.uncertainty: Availability and pricing alignment do not prove each lender, vendor, aggregator or investor is ready to accept the workflows at scale.
stories.watch: Which lenders publish UAD 3.6 exception plans before November 2, and which investors update VantageScore overlays.

stories.date_exception: Quiet banking-AI beat: this previously uncovered fraud-operations update is within seven days and operationally relevant, but it does not count toward the four fresh stories.
stories.new_fact: Feedzai launched Farol, an AI agent in RiskOps Studio for conversational intelligence, automated rule performance analytics and contextual case summaries.
stories.new_takeaway: The bank decision is whether fraud analysts can trust AI case summaries and rule analysis enough to shift staffing and control design.
stories.why_now: The item was published September 24, not used in the previous seven episodes, and fills the required banking-AI ledger update on a quiet morning.
stories.previous_coverage: Recent bank-AI sections covered Lead Bank payments, BofA treasury intelligence, LoanPro servicing, DBS routing, BNP/Gemini and Paywhere; no Feedzai fraud-analysis segment.
stories.uncertainty: No bank customer, Farol adoption, investigation-time reduction, alert-quality movement, false-positive change, loss outcome or analyst correction rate was disclosed.
stories.watch: A bank customer publishing investigation time, quality, false-positive, loss or analyst-review outcomes.
stories.ledger_row_changed: Added Feedzai / Farol fraud-analysis agent; lane 2; status announced; evidence vendor claim; metric none disclosed for Farol outcomes.

stories.new_fact: Google unveiled Gemini 4 Argon and restricted initial access to a small group of cybersecurity partners and trusted testers.
stories.new_takeaway: Frontier capability is useful only if an enterprise can actually test, govern and call the model; access restrictions are now part of the capability story.
stories.why_now: The announcement and reporting were dated September 30.
stories.previous_coverage: Recent frontier sections covered OpenAI Health tab summaries, Astra delay, OpenAI training pause, Daybreak Ukraine, Word/Voice access and model pricing; this is a new Google model/access story.
stories.uncertainty: Benchmark leadership is lab-reported at cutoff, and broad independent hands-on replication is limited by restricted access.
stories.watch: Independent or partner evidence from Gemini 4 Argon cyber pilots, plus any API, enterprise or consumer access timetable.
stories.frontier_bar: Price/access shift and frontier capability claim with restricted cyber-defense rollout.

stories.new_fact: AP reported Asian shares mostly rose early Thursday on technology optimism, while the 10-year Treasury yield rose to 5.29% and the 30-year to 5.64%.
stories.new_takeaway: AI-linked optimism and expensive long money can coexist; financing terms remain the practical constraint for lenders, utilities and local governments.
stories.why_now: AP published the market report October 1.
stories.previous_coverage: Markets have recently focused on long yields and oil; this stayed compact as routine context.
stories.uncertainty: Yields and oil can move quickly around jobs data and Iran-war headlines.
stories.watch: Whether long yields retreat after the jobs report or keep repricing mortgages, bonds and project finance.

stories.new_fact: The National Weather Service forecast generated at 2026-10-01T05:34Z called for a Columbus high near 87 Thursday and rain showers Friday with a high near 71.
stories.new_takeaway: Thursday is the better outdoor window before a wetter Friday.
stories.why_now: Daily weather forecast checked at the October 1 cutoff.
stories.previous_coverage: Routine Columbus weather appears daily and was kept brief.
stories.uncertainty: Rain timing and totals can update through Friday morning.
stories.watch: Friday rain timing and commute impact.
